en.html:
We passed each other, having come through one exchange.

Regain altitude and speed, then return to <ruby>crossing swords<rt>blade-to-blade combat</rt></ruby> with the opponent. Such was a warrior's manner of fighting.

ja.html:
一合を切り抜け、敵騎と互い違いに駆け別れる。

　そして高度と速度を確保し直してから、相手と再び
<ruby>太刀打<rt>タチウチ</rt></ruby>に臨むのが武者の戦作法だ。
